HealthStatus.description: A service's liveness marker — `ok` whenever it is serving.

oneOf.description: The service is up and serving requests.

WorkerRole.description: Identifies the service behind a health probe as the worker, distinguishing it from a backend that shares the probe shape.

description:
The body of `GET /healthz`: a worker's liveness/readiness probe and identity.

Reports `backendUrl`: the backend this worker resolves definitions from and publishes to. The UI compares it against the backend it is itself pointed at to confirm a worker shares its backend; without it the worker reads as "unverified" because there is nothing to check against.

backendUrl.description: The backend this worker resolves definitions from and publishes to (`TCAB_BACKEND_URL`). Always present — a worker requires a configured backend to start.

role.description: Identifies the service as a worker.

status.description: Liveness marker; `ok` when the worker is serving.

version.description: The contract version the worker reports, independent of the crate's build version.

title: WorkerHealth
